notes: Sweeping stairs: each floor is responsible for the entire stairwell (all 3 floors). 1st floor sweeps the stairwell closest to the parking lot, 2nd floor has the middle stairs, and 3rd floor sweeps the stairwell furthest from the parking lot. The intent is that Monday deep-cleans the stairs while Thursday does upkeep and police calls outside.

Laundry rooms: ensure dryer lint traps are free of lint and the insides of machines are free of debris. 2nd and 3rd floors must assist 1st floor with their laundry room, since that is where most of the machines in the building are.
Police call: see the barracks SOP for your area of responsibility. Please walk around this area and pick up any trash or loose branches you see.
